objective.name: meaning.update
objective.description: Incrementally refresh the root meaning projection for selected elements or contexts.

#root.role: Run a root-only incremental projection update for selected elements or contexts and expose update statistics.

elements._comment: Optional list of element refs to refresh. Each item: { ctx_id (string), element_kind (string), name (string) }. At least one of elements or context must be provided.

context._comment: Optional list of context ids (absolute paths from /root). When provided without elements, all elements in those contexts are refreshed.

updated_elements_count._comment: Number of elements refreshed in the projection.

affected_vocab_paths._comment: Vocabulary paths touched by the update.

effects.projection_db: The root meaning projection database may be updated transactionally.
effects.vocabulary_overlay: The root vocabulary overlay may be refreshed best-effort for affected paths.

transformation_contract.morphing: A root incremental update request becomes a refreshed projection state for the targeted elements or contexts, with explicit update statistics and affected vocabulary paths.
invariants: meaning.update is root-only and runs against the current projection database transactionally.
At least one of params.elements or params.context must be provided to define the update target set.
Elements that cannot be resolved or parsed are skipped rather than aborting the entire update transaction.
Incremental vocabulary enrichment applies the same semantic filtering policy as a full rebuild; the meaning rows themselves remain complete.
success: On success, meaning.update returns updated_elements_count, affected_vocab_paths, and duration_ms.
Successful updates refresh projection rows for the targeted set and apply add-only vocabulary enrichment for observed affected paths.
failure: The capacity is refused outside the root context.
The capacity fails when both params.elements and params.context are absent, when the projection database cannot be opened, or when the update transaction cannot commit.
notes: meaning.update is incremental and does not rebuild the whole projection.
Projection removals are not handled by this capability; it mainly refreshes or enriches projected content for targeted elements.

Nothing in the engine calls meaning.update automatically — edit.create, edit.patch_meaning, edit.delete, matter.write, and every other descriptor-mutating capacity write only to the filesystem and never touch the projection. This is deliberate: descriptor JSON is not required to be edited only through engine capacities (direct filesystem writes by a human or a wrapper are legitimate), so the engine cannot assume capacity calls are the only source of change and must not auto-trigger updates from them alone. Keeping the projection current after edits is an operational hygiene concern for the caller/instance, on whatever cadence or trigger fits how that instance is actually edited — there is no engine-side default.

If the projection database has no schema yet (e.g. meaning.rebuild has never run in this world, or its file was removed), meaning.update returns status=ok with updated_elements_count=0 for every targeted element instead of an error — a silent no-op, not a failure signal. A zero-update success is not proof the target elements are already up to date; if in doubt whether a rebuild has ever run, call meaning.rebuild instead of retrying meaning.update.
